title: ESP32 serial line (one per second, 115200 baud)
description: Contract v1.1, backward compatible (v1.0 lines with only voltage/current/temperature stay valid). Lines starting with '#' are firmware messages, not telemetry (v1.1 adds info lines '# fw=', '# hb', '# boot', '# ds18b20', and a throttled repeat suffix ' (x<n>)'). Producer: engines/firmware. Consumers: engines/bms/bms_engine.py parse_telemetry_line, apps/web-studio assets/js/engines/bms.js. temperature/ambient -127 means a disconnected DS18B20 and is read as null.

temperature.description: degrees C, DS18B20; null when missing

ambient.description: v1.1, optional: degrees C from a second DS18B20 on the same 1-Wire bus (index 1); null when absent. Maps to the telemetry contract's ambient_temperature_c.

seq.description: v1.1, optional: counter per telemetry line, wraps at 2^32. Gaps are counted as dropped lines.

t_ms.description: v1.1, optional: millis() at sampling time on the ESP32.

crc.description: v1.1, optional, always the last key: CRC-8 (poly 0x07, init 0x00, no reflection, no final xor) over the exact bytes from '{' up to but not including ',"crc"', two upper-case hex digits. A wrong crc: the line is skipped and counted as crc_errors, never logged as a measurement.
